records.title: Output source priority
records.content: The inverter can be configured to prioritize different power sources for supplying connected loads. Available modes and behavior depend on the inverter model.

records.title: Charger source priority
records.content: The documented inverter supports selectable charging-source priorities involving solar and utility power. Exact options depend on the model.

records.title: Maximum charging current
records.content: The manual distinguishes utility charging current from total charging current. Charging limits must be checked against the battery manufacturer's specifications.

records.title: Battery type selection
records.content: The documented inverter includes battery-type configuration. Battery chemistry must be identified before selecting charging settings.

records.title: AC input voltage range
records.content: The documented inverter provides selectable AC input voltage ranges. Program 04 controls the input range. The manual describes an appliance range of 90-280VAC and a narrower UPS range of 170-264VAC.

records.title: Solar and utility charging priority
records.content: The documented inverter allows selection of solar and utility charging priorities through Program 05. Available options depend on the model.

records.title: Flooded lead-acid battery selection
records.content: Program 17 includes FLD for flooded or water-injection lead-acid batteries. This setting is specific to the documented inverter family and is not a universal configuration code.

records.title: Low battery voltage protection
records.content: The documented inverter includes configurable battery voltage thresholds for operating-mode changes and low-voltage protection. Thresholds must be interpreted using the inverter model, battery type and battery manufacturer's guidance.
